query:
SELECT 
  s.id,
  s.saleDate,
  DATE(s.saleDate) as dateOnly,
  p.name,
  si.quantity
FROM sales s
INNER JOIN saleItems si ON s.id = si.saleId
INNER JOIN products p ON si.productId = p.id
WHERE s.id IN (13620026, 13620024, 13620015)
  AND p.name = 'Baly Maça Verde 2l'
ORDER BY s.saleDate;
